This document lists the equipment testing procedure
checklist, which must be performed for power transformers. according to each
manufacturer instructions.

A work 
 order must be issued and the qualified test group staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,

items: Isolate the transformer out of service and earth

Disassemble all clamp from bushings (Hi-voltage
 side, Low-voltage side and tertiary if exists)

The presence of current in load is signaled by
 flashing caution lamp and a display segment.

Because of the amount of energy that can be
 stored in a magnetic field, precautions should be taken before
 disconnecting the test leads from the transformer that is under test.

Never remove the leads during the testing process
 and always allow enough time (it may take several minuets) to completely
 discharge the transformer being tested.

Connect the earth of tester to common earth of
 Substation.

Connect the power cable and switch the test 
 equipment ON.

Depress the test switch and wait until the 
 current indicator reaches the maximum and stop rising. The yellow ready lamp 
 should be flashing.
The yellow flashing ready lamp means current is flowing in the load
current leads Must not be Disconnected while the lamp is flashing

You can change the range of the resistance to get accurate results, but it
 is not permitted to change the current setting while the current flow. If
 you need to change the current setting you should terminate the test.

To terminate the test, depress the dump switch, wait for the ready lamp to
 stop flashing.

Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment testing procedure
checklist, which must be performed for power transformers. according to each
manufacturer instructions.
Safety Precautions
A work 
 order must be issued and the qualified test group staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Isolate the transformer out of service and earth
Disassemble all clamp from bushings (Hi-voltage
 side, Low-voltage side and tertiary if exists)
The presence of current in load is signaled by
 flashing caution lamp and a display segment.
Because of the amount of energy that can be
 stored in a magnetic field, precautions should be taken before
 disconnecting the test leads from the transformer that is under test.
Never remove the leads during the testing process
 and always allow enough time (it may take several minuets) to completely
 discharge the transformer being tested.
Connect the earth of tester to common earth of
 Substation.
Test equipment type 
WRT100 The company address:
Electrical Testing Instruments Scarbough, Ontario Canada M1V1E7
telephone 416-292-8181, fax: 416-292-8188
The test equipment is specifically designed for the
measurement of dc resistance in high inductive alternator windings. It offers a
choice of 4 full-scale resistance ranges in 2 channels.
Test equipment type 
WRT100 The company address:
Electrical Testing Instruments Scarbough, Ontario Canada M1V1E7
telephone 416-292-8181, fax: 416-292-8188
The test equipment is specifically designed for the
measurement of dc resistance in high inductive alternator windings. It offers a
choice of 4 full-scale resistance ranges in 2 channels.
Work to be Carried Out
In case of star connection, connect the current test
 leads to each phase between HV bushing to neutral, and in case of delta
 connection put them between the two HV bushings
Connect the voltage test leads inside the current test
 leads.
Note
that: Potential test leads must not touch the current leads
Ensure that test/dumb switch is in dump 
 position (green color).
Connect the power cable and switch the test 
 equipment ON.
Depress the test switch and wait until the 
 current indicator reaches the maximum and stop rising. The yellow ready lamp 
 should be flashing.
Note :
The yellow flashing ready lamp means current is flowing in the load
current leads Must not be Disconnected while the lamp is flashing
You can change the range of the resistance to get accurate results, but it
 is not permitted to change the current setting while the current flow. If
 you need to change the current setting you should terminate the test.
To terminate the test, depress the dump switch, wait for the ready lamp to
 stop flashing.
Note: Dont operate
the tap-changer during the test otherwise the current will be disconnected.
Record the result for each phase and neutral at each tap-changer position
 in case of tapchanger on the HV side.
Repeat each step with each phase (R, S & T).
Record the results in the record sheet
Run the test with each LV winding and for each phase. In the same
 manner and the same precautions.
Record the results in the record sheet.
